**Hardware-portable**: all hardware-specific configuration (pin map, bike signal set, partition table, SDK settings) lives in one target directory under `hardware/`. A different ESP32 board or bike is a new target directory plus a PlatformIO environment. Firmware uses `#if HAS_*` guards for bike signals and `WITH_*` flags for compiled modules (§12.3).

**One header.** `board.h` is the single source of truth for pins and bike signals. It follows the framework's board contract (`framework/hardware/_common/board_contract.h`) and is authored from the framework's `framework/hardware/_TEMPLATE/`, not cloned from the reference `framework/hardware/esp32s3nano/board.h`, whose display and button pins collide with Echenon's tap pins (§12.3). No other p...

**Two flag families.** `HAS_*` macros in `board.h` state that a bike signal exists and is wired. `WITH_*` build flags in `platformio.ini` select which framework and application modules compile (§12.3).
**Build wiring.** The PlatformIO env passes `-DBOARD_HEADER=\"hardware/ex3-waveshare-nano/board.h\"`, the target's partition table and the target's `sdkconfig.defaults` (§12.2).

The cadence, potentiometer and encoder signals operate at 3.3 V logic (see [`docs/ex3_specification.md` §10](docs/ex3_specification.md#10-voltage-summary)). They reach the ESP32 only through series resistors (§4.4).

**SDK config chain.** The project-root `sdkconfig.defaults` holds the project-level defaults. The framework's `sync_sdkconfig.py` pre-script keeps it in step with the framework root file, as it does for the template app. The framework BLE defaults follow, and the target's own `sdkconfig.defaults` comes last, so the target's octal-PSRAM, 16 MB flash, USB-console and NimBLE slot settings win.

`hardware/ex3-waveshare-nano/board.h` — pin map, bike characteristics and `HAS_*` signal flags. Built from the framework's `hardware/_common/board_contract.h` and `hardware/_TEMPLATE/`, not cloned from the reference `esp32s3nano` board.

**Portal auto-starts WiFi scan on tab open:** `framework/web/portal/wifi.js` L550–561: The `tab-changed` event listener calls `startScan()` whenever the WiFi tab becomes active. If the portal is open with the WiFi tab selected, scans run automatically.

**MCP scan uses non-default active scan time:** `framework/modules/WifiManager/WifiManager.cpp` L632: When `WITH_BLE` is defined, `WiFi.scanNetworks(false, false, false, 120)` passes 120 ms/channel active scan time. The same 120 ms parameter is used in the async scan path at L741. ESP-IDF's warning specifically calls out non-default active scan time as problematic when Bluetooth is enabled.

**Active Ride Ring Buffer (`RideStore::allocateBuffer()`):** Allocates `14,400 * sizeof(RideRecord) = 115,200 B` (`112.5 KB`, 4 hours at 1 Hz) in PSRAM via `heap_caps_malloc(..., MALLOC_CAP_SPIRAM | MALLOC_CAP_8BIT)` on ESP32-S3, falling back to `3,600 * 8 = 28,800 B` (`28.1 KB`, 1 hour) in internal DRAM only if PSRAM is unavailable.

**Streaming TCX & Gzip Scratch (`TCXGenerator`):** Strictly bounded to a single `4,096 B` (`4 KB`) formatting buffer (`kScratchBufferSize = 4096`) plus streaming `miniz` (`tdefl_compressor`) deflation directly to LittleFS or HTTP response stream — zero full-ride XML strings in RAM.

**Auto-Start (`4.1`):** With `auto_start_enabled: true` (`GET /api/session/status`), pedal continuously for `> 5 s`. Verify `/ws/echenon/live` transitions `session_state: "IDLE" -> "ACTIVE"` and `session_elapsed_s` increments at 1 Hz.
**Coasting vs. Manual Pause (`4.2, 4.9`):**
Stop pedalling for `15 s` while `ACTIVE` (coasting): verify `session_state` remains `"ACTIVE"` and `0 W / 0 RPM` records are logged at 1 Hz.

Click **Pause** in the Session tab (`POST /api/session/pause`): verify `session_state` becomes `"PAUSED"`. Wait `15 s`, then click **Resume** (`POST /api/session/resume`) and pedal for another `30 s`.

**Inactivity Auto-End (`4.4`) or Manual End (`4.2`):** Stop pedalling for `180 s` (or click **End Session**). Verify trailing zero-cadence records from the final stop are stripped and the completed ride appears in `GET /api/session/history`.
**Subsequent Ride After `ENDED` (`4.1`):** Resume pedalling for `> 5 s` without rebooting; verify `SessionManager` transitions cleanly from `ENDED -> ACTIVE` with a fresh session ID.

**Manual Discard (`4.2`):** Start a short session, click **Discard**, and verify `session_state` returns to `"IDLE"` and `/ride_active.bin` is removed without adding an entry to `GET /api/session/history`.
Pedal for `> 65 s` (`>= 60` 1 Hz records, crossing at least two `30 s` LittleFS checkpoints to `/ride_active.bin`), then press hardware reset (or power-cycle USB-C) mid-ride.
On reboot, query `GET /api/session/history` and confirm `RideStore::recoverInterruptedRide()` finalized the interrupted ride into `/rides/ride_<id>.bin`.
Complete a 6th stored ride and verify `RideStore` evicts the oldest `.bin` (and any `.tcx.gz`), maintaining a maximum of `5` stored rides.
Verify unauthenticated `curl -i "http://192.168.1.100/api/session/download?id=<id>&format=tcx"` returns `HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized`.
Authenticate via the portal and download `/api/session/download?id=<id>&format=tcx` and `format=tcx.gz`.
Confirm `<TrainingCenterDatabase>` root schema and `<Creator><Name>Echenon EX-3</Name></Creator>`.

Confirm 1 Hz `<Trackpoint>` elements contain `<Time>`, `<DistanceMeters>`, `<Cadence>`, `<HeartRateBpm>` (when BLE HR connected), and `<Extensions><ns3:TPX><ns3:Speed>...</ns3:Speed><ns3:Watts>...</ns3:Watts></ns3:TPX></Extensions>`.

Confirm the `15 s` coasting window contains continuous 1 Hz `<Trackpoint>` entries with `<ns3:Watts>0</ns3:Watts>` and `<ns3:Speed>0.00</ns3:Speed>`, whereas the `15 s` manual `PAUSED` window has no `<Trackpoint>` timestamps during the pause gap.
Open the **Upload Services** tab (`#upload_settings`), enter Strava API `Client ID` and `Client Secret`, and click **Save Credentials** (`POST /api/strava/credentials`).

Click **Connect with Strava** (`GET /api/strava/auth-url`), authorize the app on Strava, and confirm redirect back to `/api/strava/callback?code=...&state=...` succeeds and `GET /api/strava/status` reports `"token_valid": true`.
Replay the same `/api/strava/callback` URL in the browser and confirm it returns `HTTP 403 Forbidden` (single-use `state` consumed).
Trigger **Upload to Strava** (`POST /api/session/upload?id=<id>`) or end a ride with auto-upload enabled:
Observe `UploadQueue` progress through `STAGE_GENERATE_TCX_GZ -> STAGE_REFRESH_TOKEN -> STAGE_POST_UPLOAD -> STAGE_POLL_STATUS` (one stage per `fetchUpdate()` tick on `Core 0`).

Confirm serial logs redact `client_secret`, `access_token`, and `refresh_token` (`***REDACTED***`), `internal_free_bytes` remains $> 40\text{ KB}$ during TLS handshakes (`BLEManager::ScanInhibit` active), `/rides/ride_<id>.tcx.gz` is deleted upon `STAGE_COMPLETE`, and the activity appears on Strava with power, cadence, heart rate, virtual speed, and distance curves.

**Zero-Cadence Guard:** If $\text{cad} \le 0.0\text{f}$ (or non-finite), return $0.0\text{f}$ ($0\text{ W}$) immediately.

**Normalized Cam Position ($\tilde{p} \in [0.0, 1.0]$):** Computed directly from the unrounded EMA float wiper $w$ (`ResistanceSensor::getFilteredWiperFloat()`) and the OLS-calibrated linear endpoints $[\text{pot}_{\min}, \text{pot}_{\max}]$ (`CalibrationWizard::fitLinearEndpoints`): $$\tilde{p} = \text{clamp}\!\left(\frac{w - \text{pot}_{\min}}{\text{pot}_{\max} - \text{pot}_{\min}},\; 0.0\tex...
**Cam Follower Displacement ($u$):** $$u = 1.0\text{f} - \cosf(2.635447\text{f} \cdot \tilde{p})$$

**Kloss Eddy-Current + Friction Power ($P$):** $$r = \frac{\text{cad}}{\text{cad}_c}, \qquad P_{\text{eddy}} = A \cdot \expf(\beta \cdot u) \cdot \frac{\text{cad}^2}{1.0\text{f} + r^2}$$ $$P = P_{\text{eddy}} + c_{\text{fric}} \cdot \text{cad}$$
**Output Clamping:** Clamp $P$ to $[0.0\text{f}, 2000.0\text{f}]$ (`uint16_t` rounded watts for FTMS / BLE / UI telemetry, plus `float` watts for internal filtering).

Per `SPEC.md` §5.3, the standard published Peloton Bike power curve is: $$P_{\text{pel}}(R_{\text{pel}}, \text{cad}) = \left(0.000185 \cdot R_{\text{pel}}^{2.7} + 0.1\right) \times \left(\frac{\text{cad}}{60}\right)^2 \times 60$$
